sentiment.instructions: Judge the overall sentiment the author expresses in this short social-media post (tweet), considering tone, emotion, and attitude toward the topic, events, or people mentioned. Ignore incidental words like 'may', ordinal dates, or event names unless they carry feeling.

criteria.positive: The author conveys happiness, excitement, anticipation, praise, admiration, affection, gratitude, well-wishes, or celebration (e.g., looking forward to an event, calling something the best, greetings like happy holidays, condolences/prayers offered warmly, promoting something enthusiastically).
criteria.neutral: The post mainly shares information, news, announcements, questions, logistics, or casual observations without clear positive or negative emotion; mild jokes or mixed/ambiguous remarks with no dominant feeling also count.
criteria.negative: The author conveys disappointment, annoyance, anger, sadness, boredom, criticism, insults, mockery, sarcasm, complaints, inability to attend something, or hostility toward a person, group, or situation.
